result.rationale: Verifiable in the diff: in group.js, addMembers/removeMember use `.then(function() { self.findMembers(); })` without returning the findMembers promise, and there is no `.fail`/error handler. So the returned promise resolves before the member list reloads, and a failed request (e.g. 422 for automatic groups, which the controller explicitly returns) fails silently with no user feedback. The controller actions (`addMembers`, `removeMember`) also do nothing with the failure. The described mechanism is accurate.
